text_blocks.snippet: For U.S. citizens looking to retire in Ecuador, the Retirement Visa (Jubilado visa) is a popular option. This visa, initially valid for two years, can be renewed or converted to permanent residency. To qualify, applicants typically need to demonstrate a stable monthly income of at least $1,410, or $1,425 if relying on Social Security or similar income, plus $250 per dependent. This income can come from pensions, Social Security, 401(k)s, IRAs, or rental income.
